summary_1line: Bhishma begins explaining why the sage Usanas (Sukra) sided with the Asuras, recounting how he used yoga to enter Kuvera and seize his wealth.

image_candidates.scene_text: Through yogic power, the ascetic Usanas mystically enters Kuvera's body and seizes the celestial lord's vast treasure.
The distressed god of wealth Kuvera approaches the fierce and radiant Mahadeva to complain about the theft of his riches.
